description: Implementation of a polling proxy configuration service with thread-safe reference counting, observer pattern, and asynchronous configuration polling.

classes.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core
classes.description: Reference-counted internal class managing configuration polling, observer notifications, and thread safety.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core::Orphan
methods.description: Prepares the service for destruction by nullifying the task runner reference.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core::GetLatestProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the latest proxy configuration if available.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to be notified of configuration changes.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core::OnLazyPoll
methods.description: Checks if it's time to poll for a new configuration.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core::CheckForChangesNow
methods.description: Initiates an immediate check for configuration changes.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core::PollAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous polling to retrieve configuration.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core::GetConfigCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of configuration retrieval and notifies observers if changed.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core::LazyInitializeOriginLoop
methods.description: Initializes the thread context for polling.
